capabilities.name: Read-only repository inspection
capabilities.activation: A fresh agent needs current branch, worktree, commit, remote, or PR evidence.
capabilities.description: Collect current repository evidence: branch state, commits, worktrees, open PRs, and file snapshots without mutation.

capabilities.name: PR comparison and collision inspection
capabilities.activation: Two or more active branches, pull requests, or planned sprint lanes touch a shared or high-risk surface.
capabilities.description: Inspect open pull requests and planned sprint ownership against base main, identify shared surfaces, and produce a deterministic collision ledger.
guardrails: do not infer local worktree state from GitHub alone

capabilities.name: Validator selection
capabilities.activation: A run context or working tree has changed paths and requires a targeted validation plan.
capabilities.description: Choose validators from the registry based on changed paths and workflow, include declared prerequisites, and fail conservatively for unmapped paths. Selection never executes commands.
guardrails: missing path mappings use the conservative fallback

capabilities.name: Local production certification
capabilities.activation: A current, green candidate SHA requires disposable local production-mode certification.
capabilities.description: Run the real production launcher against disposable loopback PostgreSQL, prove DB-free liveness, DB readiness, and built-client serving, then emit a validated local-runtime proof artifact.
guardrails: clean only resources created by the run

capabilities.name: Runtime-proof recording
capabilities.activation: A deployment-related command or observation must be recorded against a proof ceiling.
capabilities.description: Validate sanitized commands, timestamps, assertions, failures, and attained proof levels in the runtime-proof schema.

capabilities.name: Prompt-leap task-demand classification and executor routing
capabilities.activation: A task requires classification of reasoning demand and routing to an executor with proven capability evidence.
capabilities.description: Classify task demand level (bounded-deterministic through protected-runtime-judgment), compute reasoning leap from evidence vs judgment gap, factor tasks to reduce leap, and route to executor lane based on recorded capability evidence. Unknown executors fail closed.
guardrails: capability from evidence only, never brand/model
exact constraints emitted for leap reduction

capabilities.name: Account backup round-trip certification
capabilities.activation: Account backup/export/import behavior changes or a deployment candidate requires current recovery proof.
capabilities.description: Run the Backup Center semantic export/import path against disposable loopback PostgreSQL, prove dry-run and source non-mutation, task and badge parity, duplicate suppression, and ledger-safe wallet handling, then emit machine-readable certification evidence.
guardrails: never restore wallet balance from Backup Center semantic bundles

capabilities.name: Pre-deployment necessity and readiness evaluation
capabilities.activation: A release candidate is being considered for deployment and repository evidence must determine whether deployment is needed and which gates remain.
capabilities.description: Evaluate repository cleanliness, PR floor, exact candidate identity, CI, account backup proof, schema safety, build status, and local runtime proof. Classify deployment necessity and qualitative cost exposure without contacting Render or Neon or fabricating monetary pricing.
guardrails: green CI is not live-runtime proof

capabilities.name: Stateful architecture ledger validation
capabilities.activation: A task proposes serverless/stateless architecture changes or edits the Stateful Surface Ledger, its workflow, skill, registrations, report, or enforcement.
capabilities.description: Validate fail-closed stateful-surface decisions, one-seam migration boundaries, deterministic routing/registration, prompt-versus-product separation, and proof ceilings before architecture mutation.
guardrails: application logic remains in code/domain contracts
no serverless provider selected by harness policy
